node:decision.text: Project Atlas uses port 7319. This decision supersedes the old port 7300.

node:exception.text: Exception: the offline recovery endpoint must remain on port 7300. Changing the main port does not change the recovery endpoint.

node:failure.text: The first migration failed because the recovery endpoint was changed with the main endpoint. Restore recovery to 7300.

node:verification.text: Verified migration: main endpoint 7319; offline recovery 7300. Both probes passed. The earlier blanket port replacement was incorrect.
